svg.title: What every pin connects to
svg.text: The whole microcontroller system: a QSPI memory Pmod, the demo board's RP2350 as clock, reset and USB-serial bridge, plus sensors in and triggers out.
BOOT strap: high in reset = bootloader
clock, reset, straps, and the USB-C serial bridge
16 MB flash + two 8 MB RAMs; all code and data live here
every edge timestamped to the clock (all 8 inputs can capture)
pulses at an exact clock tick, set by TARM
or the demo board's 7-segment display; all can become GPIO
Signal flow: the dashes move toward the chip on inputs and away from it on outputs. Colours: purple clock/reset, blue inputs, green outputs, orange bidirectional.
